name: Berkeley Humanoid Lite
summary: An open-source, roughly US$5,000 humanoid from UC Berkeley designed so anyone can build one: modular 3D-printed cycloidal gearboxes, parts orderable from consumer e-commerce, and fully open hardware, firmware and RL training/deployment code. Intended as a customisable reference design to widen access to humanoid research.
notable: 3D-printed gearboxes; fully open hardware and learning stack
